sentences.en: I went to school this morning at eight o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上八点去了学校。

sentences.en: The first class was English.
sentences.zh: 第一节课是英语。

sentences.en: We learned new words.
sentences.zh: 我们学了新单词。

sentences.en: The teacher was kind and had much knowledge.
sentences.zh: 老师很善良，知识也很丰富。

sentences.en: She gave us a list of words.
sentences.zh: 她给了我们一张单词表。

sentences.en: We wrote them down.
sentences.zh: 我们抄写了下来。

sentences.en: In the second class, we studied science.
sentences.zh: 第二节课，我们学习了科学。

sentences.en: We did an experiment to see how plants grow.
sentences.zh: 我们做了一个实验来观察植物如何生长。

sentences.en: The third class was about history.
sentences.zh: 第三节课是关于历史的。

sentences.en: We talked about the government of our country.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了我们的国家的政府。

sentences.en: After school, I went to the library to get a book.
sentences.zh: 放学后，我去图书馆借了一本书。

sentences.en: Reading is the best way to get knowledge.
sentences.zh: 阅读是获取知识最好的方式。

sentences.en: I want to be a wise person through learning.
sentences.zh: 我想通过学习成为一个有智慧的人。

sentences.en: School is the place where I learn about the world.
sentences.zh: 学校是我了解世界的地方。

sentences.en: Education is important for every person.
sentences.zh: 教育对每个人都很重要。

sentences.en: The theory of the experiment was simple.
sentences.zh: 实验的理论很简单。

sentences.en: The fact was clear from the observation.
sentences.zh: 事实从观察中就很清楚了。

sentences.en: I made a decision to study more.
sentences.zh: 我决定更加努力学习。

sentences.en: The selection of books in the library was wide.
sentences.zh: 图书馆里的图书选择范围很广。

sentences.en: The tendency of the class was to work hard.
sentences.zh: 班级的倾向是努力学习。

sentences.en: The teacher's main role was teaching.
sentences.zh: 老师的主要角色是教学。

sentences.en: I used a pencil to write my notes.
sentences.zh: 我用铅笔写笔记。

sentences.en: The chalk on the board was white.
sentences.zh: 黑板上的粉笔是白色的。

sentences.en: We had a test on every stage of the learning.
sentences.zh: 我们在学习的每个阶段都有测试。

sentences.en: I have a conscious knowledge of right and wrong.
sentences.zh: 我对对错有清醒的认识。

sentences.en: The thread of the story was hard to follow.
sentences.zh: 故事的线索很难跟上。
